req.title: Player payload includes squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall include the squadNumber field on every response body under /players/.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-032 mandates that every response body under /players/ includes the squadNumber field. We test: (1) EP positive — GET /players/{id} for a known player returns HTTP 200 with squadNumber present and equal to the seeded value; (2) NEG negative — GET /players/{id} with a non-existent UUID returns HTTP 404 (client error path, no body to check); (3) BVA boundary — the lowest squad number (1) and highest squad number (26) in the fixture both return squadNumber in the response, catching off-by-one mutations on range checks; (4) DT decision-table — verifies squadNumber value is exactly correct (not just present) for multiple players, catching constant-mutation and field-aliasing bugs; (5) EP positive for collection endpoint — GET /players/ returns a list where every element contains squadNumber, catching mutations that strip the field from list serialization.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_includes_squad_number_positive
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows
Player with id=acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c and squadNumber=10 exists
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_id_includes_squad_number_positive():
    r = client.get('/players/acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert 'squadNumber' in body
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 10
    assert isinstance(body['squadNumber'], int)

tests.name: test_get_all_players_every_item_has_squad_number
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows
actions: Iterate over every item in the returned list
expected: Response is a list of 26 players
Every item contains key 'squadNumber' with an integer value
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_all_players_every_item_has_squad_number():
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    players = r.json()
    assert isinstance(players, list)
    assert len(players) == 26
    for player in players:
        assert 'squadNumber' in player
        assert isinstance(player['squadNumber'], int)
        assert player['squadNumber'] >= 1

tests.name: test_get_player_squad_number_exact_value_multiple_players
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows
Players with squadNumbers 10, 22, 23 exist with known UUIDs
actions: Send GET /players/{id} for Messi (squad 10), Lautaro (squad 22), D. Martinez (squad 23)
expected: Each response body contains squadNumber equal to the exact seeded value
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_squad_number_exact_value_multiple_players():
    cases = [
        ('acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c', 10, 'Messi'),
        ('79c96f29-c59f-5f98-96b8-3a5946246624', 22, 'Martínez'),
        ('01772c59-43f0-5d85-b913-c78e4e281452', 23, 'Martínez'),
    ]
    for uid, expected_squad, last_name in cases:
        r = client.get(f'/players/{uid}')
        assert r.status_code == 200
        body = r.json()
        assert 'squadNumber' in body
        assert body['squadNumber'] == expected_squad
        assert body['lastName'] == last_name

tests.name: test_get_player_squad_number_field_type_and_value_integrity
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows
Player Rodrigo de Paul with squadNumber=7 exists
actions: Assert squadNumber is integer 7, not string '7', not None, not 0
expected: squadNumber is not None, not 0, not '7'
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_squad_number_field_type_and_value_integrity():
    r = client.get('/players/0293b282-1da8-562e-998e-83849b417a42')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert 'squadNumber' in body
    squad = body['squadNumber']
    assert squad == 7
    assert squad is not None
    assert squad != 0
    assert squad != '7'
    assert isinstance(squad, int)
